title: In-process line coverage is 0.41; behaviours beyond the 26 acceptance scenarios are unverified
evidence: scores.json test_coverage=0.41; tests/acceptance/drivers.py:27 spawns server.py as a subprocess over stdio, so coverage measured in the pytest process misses soccer_data.py/soccer_tools.py executed in the child — error branches, match_statistics formatting and team_competitions output go unexercised
suggestion: Add COVERAGE_PROCESS_START subprocess coverage, or add a thin in-process unit layer over the tool functions for the formatting/error paths the stdio specs can't see

title: MCP protocol is hand-rolled over stdio rather than using the official mcp SDK
